mission_07: Optimization finds the inputs that minimize (or maximize) a function. Critical points occur where f'(x) = 0. The second derivative test classifies them: f''(x) > 0 means local minimum, f''(x) < 0 means local maximum. The global minimum is the smallest value across all local minima. In 2D, the Rosenbrock function f(x,y) = (1-x)^2 + 100(y-x^2)^2 is a classic test case with a narrow curved valley. Numerical optimizers like BFGS use gradient information to efficiently find minima. Optimization is the core of machine learning — training a model means minimizing a loss function over millions of parameters.
